description: Soft-delete a skill by id. The skill is hidden from every read path (lists, get_context, CLAUDE.md render) and will no longer materialize to disk on the next sync. Remains in the database for 30 days. To bring it back, call pathrule_update_skill with `restore: true`. Pass `hard: true` to permanently remove (workspace_admin only). After calling, relay the returned `human_message` to the user — do not paste raw tool JSON.

expected_version_id.description: Optimistic concurrency token from a prior read.

hard.description: Permanently delete (cannot be restored). Workspace_admin only. Default false (soft delete).

name: pathrule_delete_skill
title: Delete Skill
